title: SkyHands
description: A Hypixel Skyblock mod to fully customize your first-person hands and combat animations, inspired by DulkirMod.
body:
# ✋ SkyHands

**SkyHands** is a client-side Fabric mod designed to give you complete control over your first-person hands and combat animations! Inspired by classic 1.8.9 PvP mods (like DulkirMod), it brings that snappy, highly customizable visual feel to newer versions of Minecraft.

## ✨ Features
* **Custom Positioning**: Adjust the exact X, Y, and Z coordinates of your hands and held items in first-person view.
* **Scale & Rotation**: Make your items smaller, bigger, or tilt them exactly how you like.
* **Combat Animations**: Customize the swing speed, block-hit visuals, and overall combat feel to match your personal preferences.
* **Easy Configuration**: Everything is adjustable in-game! No need to restart your game or edit files manually.

## ⚙️ How to use
Simply type the dedicated command in the chat to open the configuration menu:
👉 **`/skyhands`**

From there, you can use the intuitive sliders to tweak every setting in real-time and see the results instantly.

## 📦 Dependencies
To use this mod, make sure you have the following installed in your mods folder:
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)
- [Resourceful Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/resourceful-config)

*(Optional but recommended)*: Install **ModMenu** to access the config screen directly from your main menu!

---
*Created especially for the Hypixel Skyblock community and PvP enthusiasts, but works perfectly on any server or singleplayer world!*
